stem:
Lalit stamps gift tags in a repeating cycle of length $3$: star, heart, moon, then the same three stamps again. He wants the stamp at position $17$.

Which claim correctly decides that stamp?

options.text: Divide $17$ by the cycle length $3$: remainder $2$, so position $17$ matches position $2$ — heart.
The stamp at position $17$ is the position number $17$.
Naming the stamp heart is what creates remainder $2$ for position $17$.
A growing-pattern formula $3n+1$ gives the stamp at every position $n$.

teacher.key_rationale: 17÷3 leaves remainder 2, which is heart in the star–heart–moon cycle. Calling the stamp the position number substitutes a label. Saying the stamp creates the remainder reverses the relation. A growing-pattern formula conflates a different mechanism.
